title: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION AND MATERIALS
description: An introduction to the manufacture, characteristics, sustainability, and use of construction materials in commercial and residential construction.
registration_restrictions:
Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Interior Design (458).
books_html: Low-cost:  Course material total cost is $40 or less.
clssnotes:
Required laptop/software. Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component.
